modules.name: Main
modules.responsibility: Initializes the system once, then runs one control cycle for every Tick. Corresponds to the C `main()` function.

modules.name: Initialize RVC
modules.responsibility: Puts the system into its power-on condition (FSM transition T0): resets the hidden data and issues the initial Forward command.
modules.origin: T0 + D3/D4 초기값; P4-01/02/03 개정 필요

modules.name: Controller
modules.responsibility: Runs one control cycle: obtains the inputs, decides the actions, delivers the outputs. Coordinates Process 0 for one Tick.

modules.name: Get Inputs
modules.responsibility: Obtains the two inputs the decisions need: Obstacle Situation and Dust Existence.

modules.name: Detect Obstacle
modules.responsibility: Reads the three obstacle sensors and returns them as one Obstacle Location.

modules.name: Assess Obstacle Situation
modules.responsibility: Classifies an Obstacle Location: whether the front is blocked, and whether the right is open, only the left is open, or both sides are blocked (C1, C9).

modules.name: Detect Dust
modules.responsibility: Reads the dust sensor and returns Dust Existence.

modules.name: Decide Actions
modules.responsibility: Decides the Movement Command and the Clean command for this cycle.
modules.origin: TA central coordination + P3.2.1 parameter passing

modules.name: Movement Controller
modules.responsibility: Takes one FSM transition (T1-T14) for this Tick and returns the Movement Command. Keeps the controller state.

modules.name: Reset Movement Controller
modules.responsibility: Sets the controller state to Forward and returns the initial Movement Command, Forward (T0).

modules.name: Advance Step Timer
modules.responsibility: Counts one tick of the running step and reports Step Done when 5 ticks have elapsed. Does nothing when no step is running.

modules.name: Reset Step Timer
modules.responsibility: Sets the step timer to Idle.

modules.name: Derive Movement Status
modules.responsibility: Returns Forward when the Movement Command is Forward, otherwise Avoiding.

modules.name: Track Power-Up
modules.responsibility: Starts and counts down the 5-tick power-up and reports whether it applies on this tick. Keeps the remaining count.

modules.name: Reset Power-Up Timer
modules.responsibility: Sets the remaining power-up count to 0.

modules.name: Decide Cleaning
modules.responsibility: Chooses Clean: Stop while avoiding, Power Up while power-up is active, otherwise Start.

modules.name: Put Outputs
modules.responsibility: Delivers the two decided commands to the Motor and the Cleaner.

modules.name: Issue Movement Output
modules.responsibility: Converts a Movement Command into the Direction value and sends it to the Motor.

modules.name: Read Front Sensor
modules.origin: Context terminator Front Sensor / Front Sensor Input / B6

modules.name: Read Left Sensor
modules.origin: Context terminator Left Sensor / Left Sensor Input / B6

modules.name: Read Right Sensor
modules.origin: Context terminator Right Sensor / Right Sensor Input / B6

modules.name: Read Dust Sensor
modules.origin: Context terminator Dust Sensor / Dust Sensor Input / B6

modules.name: Wait For Tick
modules.contract: Returns when the next Tick occurs
modules.origin: Context terminator Digital Clock / Tick / B6

modules.name: Drive Motor
modules.contract: Accepts Forward, Backward, Turn Left, Turn Right, or Stop

modules.name: Drive Cleaner
modules.contract: Accepts Start, Stop, or Power Up

processes.name: RVC Controller
processes.rationale: Main supplies the Tick loop. Controller performs Process 0 once per Tick.

processes.name: Control Movement
processes.rationale: Parent process; realized by its children.

processes.name: Decide Movement
processes.rationale: Parent process; realized by its children.

processes.name: Signal Obstacle Situation
processes.rationale: 3.2.1 only hands a value on as a signal. A module for it would have no body, so the hand-over is the call `Decide Actions → Movement Controller`.

processes.name: Movement Controller
processes.rationale: Movement Controller takes T1-T14. Reset Movement Controller takes T0.

processes.name: Issue Movement Output
processes.modules: Derive Movement Status, Issue Movement Output
processes.rationale: Split along the transform boundary: Movement Status feeds the decisions (central), Direction goes to the Motor (efferent). Each module now has one function.

processes.name: Time Movement Step
processes.modules: Advance Step Timer, Start Step Timer, Reset Step Timer
processes.rationale: One module per trigger of 3.2.4 (Tick, Start Step Timer) plus its initial value. They share D4 as hidden data.

processes.name: Control Cleaning
processes.rationale: Parent process; realized by its children.

processes.name: Track Power-Up
processes.rationale: Track Power-Up is the process. Reset Power-Up Timer gives D3 its initial value.
